# Once-per-campaign-and-hour guard in AdBillingRun

> Each campaign-and-hour pair is billed only once because `charge` inserts an `AdBillingRun` row, keyed by campaign and hour, in the same database transaction as the ledger journal.

_Part of [Hourly billing job charging each campaign once](hourly-billing.md)_

Billing jobs can run twice for the same hour. The hourly job may be re-run with an explicit `hour`, and the daily reconcile can also call `charge` for an hour the hourly path missed. So `charge` in [`AdBillingJobs`](ad-click-aggregation-and-billing.md) needs a hard guarantee that one campaign-hour never produces two charges. The guarantee is the `AdBillingRun` table. Its primary key is the campaign id plus the hour. `charge` opens a transaction, locks the campaign row with `FOR UPDATE`, and works out the amount. Then it runs `INSERT INTO "AdBillingRun" ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING "journalId"`. If the pair already exists, nothing comes back, and `charge` returns 0 without touching the ledger. If the insert did go through, `charge` posts the `AD_CHARGE` journal to the ledger in the same transaction, using the same `journalId`. Both writes commit together or roll back together. So there is never a billing row without a journal, or a journal without a billing row. The insert also happens when the amount is 0, so a capped-out hour is still marked as handled. See [Daily budget cap on the charged amount](daily-budget-cap.md) for how the amount is limited.

**Look at:** [ad-billing.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/infra/ad-billing.jobs.ts)

## Pieces

- Insert of the billing row that silently skips an already billed hour: An `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING` into `AdBillingRun` that returns a row only the first time a campaign-hour pair is billed.
- Billing row and ledger journal committed in one transaction: `charge` passes the same Sequelize transaction to the insert and to `ledger.post`, so the row and the `AD_CHARGE` journal succeed or fail together.
- [Daily budget cap on the charged amount](daily-budget-cap.md): The amount is limited by the daily budget minus what `AdBillingRun` already shows for that day.

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `AdBillingRun` | Primary key on campaign and hour. `charge` inserts the row with clicks, amount and journal id, and skips on conflict. It is also summed to get the amount already spent that day. |
| database | `AdCampaign` | Row is read with `FOR UPDATE` in `charge` to get the shop, price per click and daily budget, and to serialize concurrent charges for one campaign. |
| other | `Ledger journal ``AD_CHARGE``` | Posted through `LedgerService.post` in the same transaction, moving the amount from the shop account to platform fees. |

## Also relies on

- [Recording money in the ledger](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md) (domain/payments): `charge` posts the `AD_CHARGE` journal through [`LedgerService`](../domain-payments/recording-money-in-ledger.md), in the same transaction as the billing row.

## Watch out

- The guard is the insert result, not a prior check: if `RETURNING` gives no row, `charge` returns 0 and posts nothing.
- A row is inserted even when the capped amount is 0, so that hour counts as billed and will not be retried later.
- The `journalId` is a fresh `uuidv7()` on each call. It is not what makes the call safe to repeat. The primary key on campaign and hour does that.
- `reconcileDay` only calls `charge` when no `AdBillingRun` row exists. Corrections to an already billed hour go through `adjust` instead, not through a second charge.
